events.title: AI-driven controls increase substation operational complexity
events.summary: AI-assisted substation control pilots may improve operations but increase reliance on specialized equipment and integration practices. What to monitor: vendor integration notes and interconnection test plans.

events.title: Modular HVDC pilots may accelerate cross-border renewables transfer
events.summary: Modular HVDC pilots could enable incremental cross-border transfer of renewables but demand updated interconnection rules and interoperability testing. Monitor regulatory guidance and operator test notices.

events.title: Solid-state transformer supply chain exposes rare-earth dependency
events.summary: Solid-state transformer pilots may raise rare-earth material exposure. Monitor procurement and sourcing disclosures to assess scale-up risk.

events.title: Long transformer lead times create pressure for critical-spare strategies
events.summary: Extended transformer lead times push utilities toward higher spare inventories or alternative replacement services. Watch procurement and utility filings for changes in spare strategy.

events.title: On-site storage mix may shift toward sodium-ion in latency-sensitive data centers
events.summary: Some data centers are signaling trials of sodium-ion storage to diversify supply risk. Monitor pilot results and vendor safety testing.

events.title: Battery deployments could cut solar curtailment on constrained feeders
events.summary: Co-located batteries can reduce solar curtailment but need supportive tariff and connection frameworks. Watch tariff updates and connection approvals.

events.title: Cobalt concentration could keep battery supply chains strained
events.summary: Concentration of cobalt and copper supply can sustain upstream risk for batteries and equipment. Watch policy and recycling initiatives that may change sourcing dynamics.

events.title: Interconnection policy discussions could reshape capacity market outcomes
events.summary: Interconnection and capacity-market rule adjustments under discussion could alter project valuations and timing. Monitor consultation drafts and queue-processing updates.

events.title: Predictive maintenance pilots may lower outage risk if data quality is adequate
events.summary: AI predictive maintenance can lower failure risk but requires robust telemetry and validation. Monitor data quality and validation outcomes in pilots.

events.title: Aging substation assets increase localized fire-risk scenarios
events.summary: Aging equipment and deferred maintenance may raise fire-risk at certain substations. Monitor condition reports and maintenance backlogs to identify hotspots.
